metadata.description: Reduck skills — agent playbooks that drive the Reduck MCP's script catalogue.

plugins.name: amazon-research
plugins.description: Amazon US product research: search and price, full listing plus review analysis, and category watch for high-demand / poorly-rated openings.

plugins.name: facebook-leads
plugins.description: Prospect and qualify leads from Facebook Group and Page activity: find live communities, rank their posts, pull members and commenters, then qualify the promising ones.

plugins.name: geo-brave
plugins.description: Find out why an LLM never cites your site, and what to do about it. Harvests the queries Claude actually searches, then reads Brave's index — the substrate behind its web_search — to separate unreadable from unindexed from merely outranked, and picks the lever.

plugins.name: instagram
plugins.description: Read and act on Instagram: search accounts and hashtags, profiles, posts, reels, stories, comments, follower lists, feed and DMs — and, on approval, publish, comment, like, DM or follow.

plugins.name: linkedin-leads
plugins.description: Prospect, qualify and act on LinkedIn leads: seed from posts, people or company search, enrich the shortlist, find warm introductions, and reach out on approval.

plugins.name: reddit
plugins.description: Read, search and act on Reddit: trending, subreddit threads, full threads, topic search, pain-point mining — and, on approval, post, comment, vote, join or DM.
